Results.ReviewText: I've enjoyed using this grill since given it three moths ago. I've had Weber charcoal grills for 30 years and will continue for some purposes. I love that after starting the first burner on the left, the fire runs over to provide flame to start the other two.  Simple and works very well. I am impressed with how even the heat is across the entire cooking surface and the grill surface cooks nicely and cleans easily.  The grill is well made, feels "heavy" not flimsy, is attractive, rolls easily and I love how easy it is to access and hang the propane since it is not hidden behind doors. The temperature is easy to maintain at a constant setting, even a low one. I cooked a large rib roast at 225 for several hours without fussing with the controls. I love it!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
This is the second Weber grill I have owned.  Not bad considering that time frame spans over 20 years.  The first Weber grill I bought was set up to work with natural gas.  I loved that grill but when I recently moved to a part of the country that had no natural gas service I had to leave it with the house we sold.  During the time I owned that Weber grill I only replaced the grates and flavor bars as it was very well made and reliable.  If I could have converted it from natural gas to propane I would have moved it with me.  
So I recently bought the Spirit II E-310 Grill.  I got the one with the red cover because I wanted something colorful.  It really is a nice bright red.  I decided to buy it through Home Depot as they had the best price.  It was delivered to my house and I decided to assemble it myself.  The assembly instructions were easy to follow and all of the parts were present.  I just took the assembly step by step and it went together without any problems.  When I unpacked the grill I noticed a dent in the cover.  Given how well the grill was packed it must have happened during shipping with UPS.  I went online and registered my grill and in the process of doing that I notified Weber that the cover was dented.  As soon as I did that they took the information and started the process of shipping me a new cover.  Now that is outstanding customer service. No long drawn out process to get the replacement cover sent.  They even followed up with me to confirm I had received it.  
I bought this grill because it provided three burners and was reasonably priced.  In other words it had the features I needed at an affordable price.  This grill allows terrific temperature control.  I can control the temp and cooking speed by adjusting all three burners separately or turn one or more burners off completely.  This is why I own a Weber grill.  The grill is so easy to use and provides consistent high quality results.  The two shelves are perfect for holding items as I grill and the utensils hang from the one shelf keeping them in easy reach.  The electric igniter works great as well.  The results I get from this grill are excellent and exactly as I have come to expect from Weber.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: Friends' family and my family went to a cabin in Broken Bow, OK. First time we grilled loaves of pork with two sliced of pork. It took a little while to cook thoroughly. Then I grilled last of sliced porks. It was chilly outside, so I came back to inside of cabin. After a small chat, I came out to check the meat. The pork caught on fire. The bottom of the grill was melting down. Yes, it was my fault. I should have kept watching it. However, I didn't understand how the grill can be melted down while grilling. Am I only one who doesn't keep watching the grill while grilling? The worst part is the cabin owner charged me the full price of the grill as well as damange of part wooden deck because it's been only one month and the melted steel burnt the part of wooden deck as well. I called the customer center at Weber to get a replacement if it was a defective item, the call centre staff asked me to get the registered owner's info. The owner didn't even know what to do for that and had to get a new grill for next customer. So it ended up I paid for only the grill. I looked at other parts of the grill. Everything was okay except bottom of the grill. The bottom of matrials looks different than others and must be vulnerable to hot temperatures. Anyone who grills pork, don't buy this model. Or keep watching it for whole the time. I have a different Weber model at home which is a charcoal grill. Haven't had any problem at all.

Results.Title: Compact, Yet Ample Space

Results.ReviewText: Very happy with purchasing this grill. Webber grills have never disappointed.
Results.Title: Webber all the way

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I looked at grills for months before deciding on Weber.
I have used this grill for several cooks and it is entirely different than my previous grill.
A little slower cooking but no burnt food. This grill doesn't have all the gadgets of previous grill but the extras on previous grill were never used.
So far, I'm satisfied.
Results.Title: Cooking

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd Weber.  The first one was great, lasted many years until it got ruined in an ice storm.  My second was a spirit- great grill but it was hard to install the tank underneath.  My new spirit II has the gas on the outside like my 1st grill- Love It!!
Results.Title: Much Improved!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought it to repair an old grill.  This is my 4th Weber.  Great grill.
Results.Title: great grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We are in our mid 70's and this grill is by far the best grill we have ever purchased. It is easy to contact a real person to talk to at the company if you have a problem. When I called in  with a problem we had with the grill the company couldn't do enough for us. They immediately sent us a replacement part. This grill will probably out live us at this point.
Results.Title: Easy to light especially if you are elderly

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this a month ago. The igniter does sit flat on the location that it supposed to go. But works cool. Some parts could and should have been put on before shipping. Nice even heat over the cooking area. I do have a slight propane leak somewhere but haven’t gotten the time to find it yet.
Results.Title: Looks solid

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Purchased floor model.  Need to get igniter button re-attached (I imagine every prospective buyer played with it all season long).  Other than that, grill is great:  cooks perfectly, very accurate heat control, cleans easily, nothing flimsy.
Results.Title: What a grill should be

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Left my big boy genesis when I sold my house, and couldn't wait to replace it! Got the 3 burner Spirit, and it's  fantastic, so easy to produce great results.
Results.Title: Love my Webers!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I've had my grill about 2 months now and use it just about every day.  It cooks hotter than my previous grill so its taken a bit of getting use to.  I've over cooked steaks and burgers a few times so be careful.  All in all I like the grill it seems to be well built has great features.  I think the sensor system would be a good purchase for less experienced grillers.
Results.Title: Overall a good grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: After owning several brands of grill over the years, I've found Weber to be simply the best.
Results.Title: The Best

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Researched on the internet and decided this was what I needed for a grill for burgers and steak.  Our 44th wedding anniversary steak dinner with asparagus mushrooms, onions was perfect.  Easy to use, clean, and store, what more can you say.
Results.Title: I am going to have a Tim Taylor meat fest yahoo!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I hope that it lasts 15 years like my other Weber grill
Results.Title: Great grill just like my previous Weber grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Our last Weber grill had been at the center of our favorite meals for the last 18 years, and it's still going - but has been passed on to my daughter and her family. I bought this one as a surprise birthday gift for my husband, and he was so excited when he laid eyes on it! He is enjoying exploring the upgrades, and we are so pleased with it. I expect it to be with us into our old age!
Results.Title: Welcome to our family!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We purchased less than a month ago and were able to use it twice before cold weather arrived.  Depending on temperatures we hope to continue to use it through the winter.
Results.Title: Great Replacement

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I had a party at our house two weeks ago where I grilled 11lbs of beef; short ribs and carne asada strips, chicken breasts, husked corn, sweet potato's, jalapeños, tortillas, green onions. I fed 13 people Quickly off of this three burner. My old grill was a 5 burner Dyna-Glo and my new Weber is far superior. The Sizzle! Oh my the SIZZLE. Just buy one.
Results.Title: Beyond BEST Expectations

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Had it about a month now and I really think it was well worth it.  Everything seems to cook so much better. High temps, low temps, even heat on the grill, it does it all.
Results.Title: Love it !!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Love it !!! Does exactly what we purchased it to do !!!
Results.Title: Love it !!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I simply love cooking on this grill. The only down side is it doesn’t have casters on the front legs. A friend has the same grill only it’s a 2 burner and it has casters in all 4 legs much easier to move around. I am now trying to figure a way to put casters on the front.
Results.Title: Good featured

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
